registry: THE ORACLE'S TAPES — schema registry (OR-2 STEP 7, ruling R-6)
ruled: R-6 (operator 2026-09-22, ratified 'leans'): register v1 and v2, the reader rule, parquet key-value metadata on new tapes; the 2026-09-21 file registered by name and NOT rewritten. AS RULED IN-SESSION 2026-09-23 (Q-1, 'A-OR1-1 stands'): v1 covers the files before 2026-09-21 AND from 2026-09-23 on, v2 the 2026-09-21 file only, and the tape_ranges/ sibling has its own version; no column goes back into the main tape (A-OR1-1 v: range records go to the sibling; the TC4 tape's schema is untouched).
metadata_rule: every tape written by oracle_daily from OR-2 STEP 7 on carries parquet key-value metadata naiad_tape_schema=<its version id>; files written before carry none and are registered by their date (and 2026-09-21 by its name). Required on every file dated after 2026-09-23.
reader_rule: Concatenate by column UNION; a v1 row reads null in every v2-only column. Read FILE BY FILE (glob the file pattern, pd.read_parquet each, pd.concat) — NEVER a directory as one dataset: this JSON is not parquet, a dataset read takes the FIRST file's schema and silently drops the 2026-09-21 range columns, and 'closed_by' is typed null in some files and string in others (cast it to string). Range records for any other date are in the sibling tape (tape_ranges/), joined on (as_of_ms, asset, lens).

1.status: CURRENT — the TC4 event tape (D-4), the pre-OR-1 24 columns
1.rows: one per asset with no window, else one per open window + each window dead within DEAD_MEMORY_BARS

columns.name: as_of_ms
columns.meaning: open time (ms UTC) of the station's as-of bar on the lens — the row's own last cached bar

columns.name: as_of_iso
columns.meaning: the same instant, ISO-8601 UTC

columns.name: asset
columns.meaning: the roster symbol (<X>USDT)

columns.name: lens
columns.meaning: the station's lens (REGISTER['LENS'], '4h')

columns.name: station
columns.meaning: the posture word: the asset's Board word on a no-window row, else that window's own word (TRIGGERED / ARMED / STALKING / DEAD); unchanged by design (A-BR2-1b)

columns.name: tide
columns.meaning: the 89/316 tide: 'long', 'short' or 'none'

columns.name: tide_flip_ms
columns.meaning: open time of the last 89/316 tide flip (the C-4 anchor)

columns.name: direction
columns.meaning: the window's direction, +1 long / -1 short; null on a no-window row

columns.name: arm_ms
columns.meaning: open time of the 12/89 arming bar

columns.name: age_bars
columns.meaning: bars from the arming to the as-of bar (alive) or to the close (dead)

columns.name: disp_atr
columns.meaning: |close - e89| / ATR at the cross (Window.disp)

columns.name: d_ok
columns.meaning: the displacement test passed

columns.name: trigger_ms
columns.meaning: open time of the in-window 12/26 trigger bar; null if untriggered

columns.name: trigger_on_arming_bar
columns.meaning: the trigger fired on the arming bar itself

columns.name: closed_by
columns.meaning: 'counter-12_89' or 'bell-89_316'; null while alive or on a no-window row

columns.name: close_px
columns.meaning: close of the as-of bar

columns.name: atr_lens
columns.meaning: ATR on the lens

columns.name: atr_daily
columns.meaning: daily ATR (daily_atr of the 1h tape)

columns.name: n_levels
columns.meaning: size of the level registry

columns.name: n_clusters
columns.meaning: number of level clusters

columns.name: nearest_cluster_atr
columns.meaning: |nearest scored cluster mean - price| / atr_daily; NaN if none

columns.name: nearest_cluster_score
columns.meaning: that cluster's score

columns.name: heat
columns.meaning: score / (1 + nearest_cluster_atr), 0.0 with no cluster (REGISTER['HEAT'], [VETO], deferred to BR-2)

columns.name: payload_sha
columns.meaning: sha256 of the asset's mantle payload

columns.name: range_state
columns.meaning: RangeFinder v2 MACRO state: NEUTRAL, BULL_EXP or BEAR_EXP; 'UNAVAILABLE' if the machine failed or the view carried no range — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_top
columns.meaning: top of the live CONFIRMED macro range (redrawn so far); null when there is none — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_bottom
columns.meaning: bottom of the same range; null when there is none — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_pos_pct
columns.meaning: 100 * (close - bottom) / (top - bottom), unclamped (below 0 or above 100 during a breach) — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_dist_atr
columns.meaning: distance to the nearest macro boundary in ATR(14) on the 4h tape; null with no range or no valid ATR — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_pending_side
columns.meaning: 'top' or 'bottom' while a breach is open, else null — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_last_event
columns.meaning: the last non-pivot macro event (breach-open, memory-touch, redraw, potential-invalidate, potential-superseded, inception-deviation …) — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows

columns.name: range_last_event_age_bars
columns.meaning: bars since that event (n - 1 - i) — asset-level, repeated on each of the asset's rows
